ackermann.title: Ackermann
ackermann.description: Recursive A(3, n), stressing nested function calls.

sieve.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
sieve.description: Count primes up to and including n using a boolean sieve.

quicksort.title: Quicksort
quicksort.description: In-place middle-pivot quicksort of a deterministic LCG sequence; validate order and a weighted checksum.

matrix.title: Matrix multiplication
matrix.description: Flat row-major matrices; explicit i/j/k cubic multiplication and sum of all result entries.

mandelbrot.title: Mandelbrot
mandelbrot.description: n by n grid on [-2, 1) by [-1, 1), capped at 60 iterations; sum escape iteration counts.

nqueens.title: N-Queens
nqueens.description: Backtracking with explicit column and diagonal checks; count all solutions.

binary_trees.title: Binary trees
binary_trees.description: Build and recursively count eight complete binary trees of depth n.

spectral_norm.title: Spectral norm
spectral_norm.description: Ten power iterations of the implicit benchmark matrix; return squared spectral norm to avoid a library square root.

collatz.title: Collatz
collatz.description: Sum steps to reach 1 for starting integers 1 through n; no memoization.
